item.title: US ban on $1bn of Canadian goods takes effect in Trump’s latest retaliation
item.description: Trump retaliated against Canada's counter-tariffs on $20bn worth of US imports by banning $1bn of Canadian goods.

item.title: Has Gaza broken the Israel consensus in the US?
item.description: For decades, Israel was untouchable in Washington. Gaza changed that. Josh Rushing investigates how and what comes next.

item.title: US troops fully withdraw from Baghdad base after two decades
item.description: US Army soldiers have fully withdrawn from the US base in Baghdad.

item.title: Can Iraq handle future security challenges alone?
item.description: More than two decades of US military presence in Iraq comes to an end.

item.title: Madrid residents feel the impact of Spain’s housing crisis
item.description: Spain’s housing crisis is deepening as soaring rents and a shortage of homes put affordable housing out of reach.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli worshippers attack Palestinian man
item.description: Settler pogroms intensify as a total lockdown of the occupied West Bank enters its third day.

item.title: Trump unveils new site to simplify access to government services
item.description: America.gov for now functions like a chatbot comparable to ChatGPT or Claude, pointing users to official gov't websites.

item.title: Morocco’s king names Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri first woman PM
item.description: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri becomes the second woman to serve as prime minister in the Arab world.

item.title: Schoolboy kills teacher, injures two in Slovakia school stabbing
item.description: Police detain the 13-year-old in the northwestern village of Staskov, launch investigation into 'premeditated murder'.

item.title: Trump administration ‘must be changed’: Iran’s IRGC appeals to US voters
item.description: Iran's military has issued an open letter accusing Trump of lying to US citizens about the state of the ongoing war.

item.title: Ethiopia blames regional rivals as risk of conflict spillover rises

item.title: Mourners in Gaza bury remains of loved ones killed in 2023 Israeli strike

item.description: UK prime minister tells his first Labour Party conference 'fundamental rethink' needed to set Britain on right course.

item.title: Russian Tu-95 nuclear-capable bomber plane crashes, killing six people
item.description: Tu-95 plane crashed during training flight in uninhabited area of Amur region, Defence Ministry says.

item.title: LIVE: Spain vs Croatia – Nations League
item.description: Build-up, teams and live text coverage as World champions Spain host Croatia on matchday two of the UEFA Nations League

item.title: ‘The emperor is naked’: UEFA’s Ceferin takes aim at FIFA boss Infantino
item.description: UEFA slams Infantino over his aborted plan to sell off stakes in FIFA competitions to private investors.

item.title: Yemen’s war disrupts roads and ports, deepening humanitarian crisis

item.title: US-Iran talks in New York: What’s the latest?

item.title: Why has Putin added 15,000 new soldiers to Russia’s army?

item.title: Indian firm building $15bn Trump-announced steel mill has deep Russia ties
item.description: Russian cash helped Essar, the firm behind the steel factory, manage major debts. Now the group's investing in the US.

item.title: Sudan takes centre stage on final day of UNGA
